title: Tribal Totem
start: Speak to Kangai Mau in Brimhaven.

recommended.t: About 90 coins (a ring of charos (a) or Karamja gloves lowers the cost)
Activated Ardougne lodestone and Karamja lodestone
An amulet of glory or a player-owned house in Brimhaven

rewards.t: 5 swordfish (if you don't have enough inventory space, they will appear on the ground)

steps.t: Talk to Kangai Mau in the large building north of Brimhaven's pub. [Chat: 2 I'm in search of adventure! › Accept]
Travel to Ardougne (you can take a ship from Brimhaven to complete Avast Ardougne!, an easy Karamja achievement), and head to the RPDT depot just south of the eastern bank.
Investigate the crate directly north-east of the sacks for the address label.
Use the address label on the stack of two crates directly north of the crate you just investigated.
Talk to an RPDT employee and ask when the crate will be delivered. [Chat: 1 So, when are you going to deliver this crate?]

Talk to Wizard Cromperty in the house north-east of the Ardougne market (the one with the blue checkered floor). [Chat: 2 So what have you invented? › 2 Can I be teleported please? › 1 Yes, that sounds good. Teleport me!]
Once inside the mansion, open the western door, using the code "KURT" to get in.
Right-click Investigate the stairs, then Climb-up them.
Once upstairs, enter the next room, Open the chest, then Search it for a totem.
p: Retrieving the totem from the mansion.

steps.t: Talk to Kangai Mau in Brimhaven with the totem.

get_inside.text: Brimhaven is located immediately north of the Karamja lodestone.

Brimhaven has a ship ride that will take the player to Ardougne for the low price of 30 coins. This ship is located in the northern part of Brimhaven. The price is lowered to 15 coins after completing the Easy Karamja achievements. Wearing a Ring of charos (a) will allow you to travel to and from Brimhaven for free.
The charter ships also dock in the Brimhaven Harbour. They provide rides to several other locations, for a fee.
If you have completed the Shilo Village quest, then Hajedy will take you for a ride in his cart to Shilo Village for the fee of 10-200 coins.

The House Teleport spell can be used if player-owned house is in Brimhaven. If the Love Story quest has been completed, players can use a Brimhaven tablet (made from a chipped Teleport to House tablet) to teleport to the Brimhaven house portal, even if their house is located elsewhere.
The amulet of glory teleport to Musa Point, east of Brimhaven.

If the Holy Grail and A Fairy Tale Part II quests are completed, the Fisher Realm can be reached through the fairy ring system by using code BJR. Use the magic whistle, found at the northwest corner of the Fisher Realm, to exit the Fisher Realm and end up on the northwestern peninsula near the gold mine and Brimhaven.
Go through the Spirit tree network by a planted Spirit Tree with 83 Farming Boostable on the Spirit Tree Patch north-east of the Brimhaven.
